title: Nutty Tender Mexican Fennel Stir-fry
description: A vibrant and flavorful dish, inspired by the bold flavors of Yucatecan cuisine. Crunchy fennel, toasted pecans, and a hint of ancho chili powder come together to create a truly special stir-fry.
instructions: Toast the pecans in a small skillet over medium heat for 2-3 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of avocado oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped fennel and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the toasted pecans, cumin, ancho chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Stir-fry for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
Serve the stir-fry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Optional: Serve with a side of cauliflower rice or tortillas.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
